id: # Runtime voice: Mission Control reports with the crew history of the kerbal it talks to ({kerbal}). The format is explained at the top of reports.tsv.

spanish: {kerbal}, es tu primer vuelo. Respira y disfruta. | {kerbal}, primer vuelo. Todos nos acordamos del nuestro. | {kerbal}, es tu primer vuelo. No toques el botón rojo.
english: {kerbal}, it's your first flight. Breathe and enjoy it. | {kerbal}, first flight. We all remember ours. | {kerbal}, it's your first flight. Don't touch the red button.

spanish: {kerbal}, este es tu vuelo número {flight_no}. Ya eres de la casa. | {kerbal}, vuelo {flight_no}. Ya te sabes el camino a la plataforma. | Vuelo número {flight_no} para {kerbal}. Seguimos contando.
english: {kerbal}, this is flight number {flight_no} for you. You're family now. | {kerbal}, flight {flight_no}. You know the way to the pad by now. | Flight number {flight_no} for {kerbal}. We're still counting.

spanish: {kerbal}, con {missions} vuelos a la espalda, esto es rutina para ti. | {kerbal}, {missions} misiones. Tienes más horas de vuelo que el cohete. | Con {missions} vuelos, {kerbal}, deberías dar tú las clases.
english: {kerbal}, with {missions} flights behind you, this is routine. | {kerbal}, {missions} missions. You have more flight hours than the rocket. | With {missions} flights, {kerbal}, you should be teaching the classes.

spanish: {kerbal}, es tu primera vez en {body}. Saluda de nuestra parte. | {kerbal}, primera visita a {body}. Haz muchas fotos. | Nunca habías estado en {body}, {kerbal}. ¿Qué te parece?
english: {kerbal}, it's your first time at {body}. Say hi for us. | {kerbal}, first visit to {body}. Take lots of photos. | You've never been to {body}, {kerbal}. What do you think?

spanish: {kerbal}, ya has estado en {body} en {visits} viajes. Tú nos guías. | {kerbal}, {visits} viajes a {body}. Ya deberías tener casa aquí. | {body} otra vez, {kerbal}. Van {visits} viajes.
english: {kerbal}, you've been to {body} on {visits} trips. You lead the way. | {kerbal}, {visits} trips to {body}. You should have a house here by now. | {body} again, {kerbal}. That's {visits} trips.

spanish: {kerbal}, tú ya conoces {body}. Ya aterrizaste aquí antes. | {kerbal}, ¿reconoces el sitio? Ya pisaste {body} antes. | Otra vez en {body}, {kerbal}. Esta vez trae un recuerdo.
english: {kerbal}, you know {body}. You landed here before. | {kerbal}, recognize the place? You've walked on {body} before. | On {body} again, {kerbal}. Bring a souvenir this time.

spanish: {kerbal}, con nivel {stars} ya no hace falta que te digamos nada. | {kerbal}, nivel {stars}. Los novatos te miran con envidia. | Experiencia de nivel {stars}, {kerbal}. Confiamos en ti.
english: {kerbal}, at level {stars} we don't need to tell you anything. | {kerbal}, level {stars}. The rookies look at you with envy. | Level {stars} experience, {kerbal}. We trust you.

spanish: {kerbal}, tu segundo vuelo. Ahora ya sabes lo que viene. | Segundo vuelo para {kerbal}. Menos nervios que la primera vez, esperamos.
english: {kerbal}, your second flight. Now you know what's coming. | Second flight for {kerbal}. Fewer nerves than the first time, we hope.

spanish: {kerbal}, ya llevas {missions} misiones. Te estás haciendo un nombre. | Con {missions} misiones, {kerbal}, ya no eres novato.
english: {kerbal}, {missions} missions already. You're making a name for yourself. | With {missions} missions, {kerbal}, you're no rookie anymore.

spanish: {kerbal}, {missions} misiones. En la cafetería ya tienes tu propia taza. | {missions} misiones, {kerbal}. Los niños tienen tu póster.
english: {kerbal}, {missions} missions. You have your own mug in the cafeteria. | {missions} missions, {kerbal}. Kids have your poster.

spanish: {kerbal}, tu primer aterrizaje en {body}. Mira dónde pisas. | Primera vez en la superficie de {body}, {kerbal}. Guarda una piedra.
english: {kerbal}, your first landing on {body}. Watch your step. | First time on the surface of {body}, {kerbal}. Keep a rock.

spanish: {kerbal}, ya has aterrizado {landings} veces en {body}. Es tu segunda casa.
english: {kerbal}, you've landed on {body} {landings} times. It's your second home.

spanish: {kerbal}, segunda vez en {body}. Ya conoces el camino. | Vuelves a {body}, {kerbal}. ¿Te dejaste algo la última vez?
english: {kerbal}, second time at {body}. You know the way. | Back at {body}, {kerbal}. Did you forget something last time?

spanish: {kerbal}, aún sin estrellas. Este vuelo puede cambiarlo.
english: {kerbal}, no stars yet. This flight could change that.

spanish: {kerbal}, tanto viaje y al final siempre vuelves a {body}.
english: {kerbal}, all those trips and you always come back to {body}.
